description: This PHP file defines the EmployeeImmigrationController class within the OrangeHRM application. It manages the rendering of the employee immigration view, prepares Vue components with necessary properties, and handles permissions based on employee data.

classes.name: EmployeeImmigrationController
classes.description: Controller class managing the Employee Immigration view, extending BaseViewEmployeeController, handling pre-rendering setup, permissions, and data preparation for Vue components.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with employee immigration data and permissions if an employee number is provided; otherwise, handles a bad request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns data groups relevant for capability permission checks, specifically 'immigration'.
